system.description:
You manipulate your water release chakra molding it until you manifest a single gargantuan shark that you then launch at a creature within range, leaving a trail of devastation in its path.

The shark is propelled in a straight line towards a single target creature. Make a ranged Ninjutsu Attack. On a success they take cold damage equal to 9d8, and must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the shark slams its fangs into the target, leaving it Restrained and unable to cast jutsu that require Hand Seals (HS).

All creatures the shark would pass through while traveling to the target creature would suffer some effect as well. Draw a line from yourself to the target. All creatures the line passes through makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 cold damage and are knocked Prone on a failed save or half as much on a successful on.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 2d8.
